## 105. Al-Fil

**ٱلْفِيل** · Al-Fil · Meka kumate · 5 agirama'a

*Ante'nee kagra ompge seen a' afu' tamagri Ra teart a' afu' afina tagrote' vhe' a' isa gi'nee afina erefant?*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**105:1** Ante'nee kagra ompge agu'a agra anthi'nee a' afu' tamagri Ra teart a' afu' afina vahe a' isa gi'nee afina erefant?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

**105:2** Tit agra ompge tro' hu'nee zamagri pran vu'ne hviza?

أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ

**105:3** Agra sent against zamagra svarms a' isa gi'nee ki'a.

وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

**105:4** Mte vu'nee kzunti ami'nee zamagra rokks a' isa gi'nee paket higo mopa.

تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ

**105:5** Atre'nee zamagra anahu'nee sevet-anaga hu'nee.

فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

---

## 106. Quraysh

**قُرَيْش** · Quraysh · Meka kumate · 4 agirama'a

*Hoka'a afina sekuritz a' isa gi'nee Kurais — zamagri journezs ane' vinter hagi summer.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**106:1** Hoka'a afina sekuritz a' isa gi'nee kurais.

لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

**106:2** Zamagri sekuritz turing vinter hagi summer journezs.

إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

**106:3** Atre'nee zamagra mono afina Ra a' isa gi'nee ama no.

فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

**106:4** Vho has fet zamagra against hunger, hagi has sekuret zamagra against aginki agonko are hu'nee.

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

---

## 107. Al-Ma'un

**ٱلْمَاعُون** · Al-Ma'un · Meka kumate · 7 agirama'a

*Ante'nee kagra seen afina mgoke' vho tenies afina jutgement? Agra me'nee agra vho puses erino' vu'nee afina orfan.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**107:1** Ante'nee kagra agu'a agra anthi'nee agra vho tenies afina mono'?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**107:2** Agra me'nee agra vho mistreats afina orfan.

فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**107:3** Hagi hu'nee ompge enkourag afina afi ami'nee a' isa gi'nee afina amunte' vzi'nee.

وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**107:4** Hagi oe atamna' hu'nee amu vho agihanta' vzi'nee.

فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

**107:5** Amu vho reraga hu'nee heetress a' isa gi'nee zamagri nunamu.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

**107:6** Amu vho ante'nee anare' afina appearans.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

**107:7** Hagi vithort afina assistans.

وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

---

## 108. Al-Kawthar

**ٱلْكَوْثَر** · Al-Kawthar · Meka kumate · 3 agirama'a

*Tagra ante'nee given kagra apuntans — hagi agihanta' vzi'nee atamna' hu'nee tamagri Ra hagi sakrifis.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**108:1** Tagra ante'nee given kagra prentz.

إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

**108:2** Hagi agihanta' vzi'nee atamna' hu'nee tamagri Ra hagi sakrifis.

فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

**108:3** Agra vho ave' osi'nee kagra me'nee afina roser.

إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

---

## 109. Al-Kafirun

**ٱلْكَافِرُون** · Al-Kafirun · Meka kumate · 6 agirama'a

*Hu'nee: o tisperievers, nagra hu'nee ompge mono vhat kagra mono.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**109:1** Hu'nee, “o tisperievers.

قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

**109:2** Nagra hu'nee ompge mono vhat kagra mono.

لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**109:3** Nor hu'nee kagra mono vhat nagra mono.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:4** Nor hu'nee nagra afi ami'nee vhat kagra afi ami'nee.

وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

**109:5** Nor hu'nee kagra afi ami'nee vhat nagra afi ami'nee.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:6** Kagra ante'nee tamagri ange', hagi nagra ante'nee nagri ange'.”

لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

---

## 110. An-Nasr

**ٱلنَّصْر** · An-Nasr · Madina kumate · 3 agirama'a

*Tasnempe'nee afina kto a' isa gi'nee Anumzamo e'nee, hagi kani re'nee, hagi kagra ke'nee vahe mreri'nee afina mono' ane' hakare vhe'.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**110:1** Tasnempe'nee amu e'nee Anumzamofo kani re'nee, hagi konkuest.

إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

**110:2** Hagi kagra ke'nee afina vahe mreri'nee Anumzamofo mono' ane' murtitutes.

وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا

**110:3** Anante' sereprat afina agi erisga hu'nee a' isa gi'nee tamagri Ra, hagi hakre'nee agri forgiveness. Agra me'nee afina aksepter a' isa gi'nee repentans.

فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

---

## 111. Al-Masad

**ٱلْمَسَد** · Al-Masad · Meka kumate · 5 agirama'a

*Fri'nee afina azana ami'nee a' isa gi'nee afina nefa a' isa gi'nee fram — mgo' ve a' isa gi'nee afufeno, mgo' nenaro' vho avre'nee firevoot.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**111:1** Kontemnet reraga hu'nee afina azana ami'nee a' isa gi'nee ape rahap, hagi agra me'nee kontemnet.

تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ

**111:2** Agri afufeno tit ompge avair agra, nor tit vhat agra eri'nee.

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

**111:3** Agra agu'a purn ane' mgo' framing teve.

سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ

**111:4** Hagi agri nenaro' — afina firevoot karrier.

وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

**111:5** Anu' eri'nee agri agetu me'nee mgo' nofi' a' isa gi'nee torns.

فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

---

## 112. Al-Ikhlas

**ٱلْإِخْلَاص** · Al-Ikhlas · Meka kumate · 4 agirama'a

*Hu'nee: agra me'nee Anumzamo, mgoke'. Anumzamo, afina apsorut. Agra pegets ompge, nor me'nee agra pegotten.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**112:1** Hu'nee, “agra me'nee Anumzamo, afina mgoke'.

قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

**112:2** Anumzamo, afina apsorut.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

**112:3** Agra pegets ompge, nor vas agra pegotten.

لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

**112:4** Hagi amu me'nee ompge komparapr atamna' hu'nee agra.”

وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

---

## 113. Al-Falaq

**ٱلْفَلَق** · Al-Falaq · Meka kumate · 5 agirama'a

*Hu'nee: nagra hakre'nee refug ane' afina Ra a' isa gi'nee tazpreak, asime' afina kefo a' isa gi'nee vhat agra erifore' hu'nee.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**113:1** Hu'nee, “nagra afi'nee refug a' afu' afina Ra a' isa gi'nee tazpreak.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

**113:2** Asime' afina kefo a' isa gi'nee vhat agra erifore' hu'nee.

مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

**113:3** Hagi asime' afina kefo a' isa gi'nee afina tarkness anahu'nee agra hantge'nee.

وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

**113:4** Hagi asime' afina kefo a' isa gi'nee amu vho avame' hu'nee sorserz.

وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

**113:5** Hagi asime' afina kefo a' isa gi'nee mgo' envious tasnempe'nee agra envies.”

وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

---

## 114. An-Nas

**ٱلنَّاس** · An-Nas · Meka kumate · 6 agirama'a

*Hu'nee: nagra hakre'nee refug ane' afina Ra a' isa gi'nee mankint, afina kini a' isa gi'nee mankint, afina Anumzamo a' isa gi'nee mankint.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Anumzamofo agifine, Agampu, Asunku*

**114:1** Hu'nee, “nagra hakre'nee refug ane' afina Ra a' isa gi'nee mankint.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:2** Afina kini a' isa gi'nee mankint.

مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:3** Afina Anumzamo a' isa gi'nee mankint.

إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:4** Asime' afina kefo a' isa gi'nee afina sneakz vhisperer.

مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

**114:5** Vho vhispers into afina agu'a a' isa gi'nee vahe.

ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:6** Asime' anampi jinn hagi anampi vahe.”

مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

---
